lines.1: Before dinner, I took a bath.
lines.2: Dinner after a bath would taste even better--
lines.4: A jumbo-sized rice ball was suddenly handed to me.
lines.7: For some reason, she stared at me while I ate.
lines.14: 「If it's too big, I might not be able to finish it...」
lines.15: The direction her kindness was taking was a little unsettling.
lines.18: 「All right. Since you look pleasantly stuffed, I have a question for you.」
